body:
# stroopwafel advanced
my mod adds a dutch food called the stroopwafel to minecraft along with its ingiedients like butter flour  syrup and a waffle cone
## obtaining
u can obtain the stroopwafel by crafting it using a waffle cone and syrup in order to obtain syrup u just smelt sugar in a furnace and for the waffle cone u craft it using butter, eggs, flour and sugar to obtain butter u put a bucket of milk along with sugar and a brown mushroom in the crafting table in this video u will see the whole process tap [here](https://medal.tv/nl/games/minecraft/clips/lFqS9qJhalprw63fy?invite=cr-MSx6YnEsMzI5Mzg2ODkx&v=104) all the images of the crafting grids are in the gallery
